reference.title: To mark a field as Smart

ol.li: Insert the field into your template by following the steps in Inserting Fields in a Template.

li.p: From the X-Author Templates pane, go to Work tab > Template Fields. If you cannot see the Template Fields tab, click more icon and select Template Fields.

ol.li: The Template Fields page shows the list of all the fields present in your template. Search for and click the field name in the list to highlight it in the document.

li.p: Click the gear icon adjacent to the selected field name to open the Properties page.

ol.li: In the attributes list turn on the Smart Field switch and click Ok.

section.title: Result
section.p: If you want to turn off the smartness property of a field, turn off the Smart Field switch, under Properties.
